questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

118, 129, 141, 154, 168, ?

questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

1st number = (3rd number - 2ⁿd number)² (from top to bottom)

64 = (20 - 12)² = 8² = 64

49 = (24 - 17)² = 7² = 49

Similarly,

? = (8 - 4)² = 4² = 16

Hence, 16 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All postcards are envelopes.

No envelope is a paper.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some envelopes are postcards.

II. No paper is an envelope.

III. No postcard is a paper.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
All the conclusions, I, II and III, follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The best possible Venn diagram according to the information is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/517ae66688acf5afd98a5762c61da5e800af56f553f348becdb5c5ec71635bdd.png] 

I. Some envelopes are postcards → True, as all postcards are envelopes, some envelope will definitely be the postcards.

II. No paper is an envelope → True, as no envelope is a paper.

III. No postcard is a paper → True, as postcards are envelopes, and no envelop is a paper.

Hence, all conclusions I, II and III follow.

questions.question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A - B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

If P + S × Q × R - T ÷ V ÷ U, then how is T related to P?
questions.solution:
Given equation: P + S × Q × R - T ÷ V ÷ U

P + S means P is brother of S

S × Q means S is daughter of Q

Q × R means Q is daughter of R

R - T means R is wife of T

T ÷ V means T is father of V

V ÷ U means V is father of U

Thus, using the following notations, we can draw the family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/288449dd26d10f53283999d395a4806249568144fc2ce8807ef4f923639d596f.png] 

Best possible diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b36b7e45b7ab587542f41d8e887aea790f1fae6d2ab1d1c2fd02e70ba4fcf164.png] 

Hence, T is P’s maternal grandfather.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

7 : 344 :: 11 : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

2ⁿd number = (1st number)³ + 1

344 = (7)³ + 1 = 343 + 1 = 344

Similarly,

? = (11)³ + 1 = 1331 + 1 = 1332

Hence, 1332 is the correct answer.

questions.question: The sum of the current ages of Asma and her grandfather is 80 years. 10 years from now, Asma’s age will be one-fourth of her grandfather’s age. What is Asma’s current age?
questions.solution:
As per the question,

Let current age of Asma be X and that of her grandfather be Y.

Sum of their age = X + Y = 80 …(i)

Age 10 years from now,

X + 10 will be of Asma and Y + 10 of her grandfather, also given that

X + 10 = 1/4 (Y + 10) …(ii)

From (i) X = 80 - Y put in (ii)

80 - Y + 10 = 1/4 (Y + 10)

90 - Y = 1/4 (Y + 10)

360 - 4Y = Y + 10

5Y = 350

Y = 70

Put Y = 70 in (i)

Therefore, X = 10

Hence, 10 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

PRT, TVX, ?, BDF, FHJ
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f0a3e32b57e2393fbe73836962f87739b4ab822af37a0422d586f9f9d371458.png] 

The pattern followed here is,

P + 2 = R + 2 = T

T + 2 = V + 2 = X

**X + 2 = Z + 2 = B**

B + 2 = D + 2 = F

F + 2 = H + 2 = J

Hence, XZB is the correct answer.
